description:
Make the `.agents/skills/jit-project-lead/scripts/test-standards-scan.sh` self-test pass as the registered gate `standards-scan-test` over the script it tests.

## Background

`.agents/skills/jit-project-lead/scripts/test-standards-scan.sh` is a re-runnable self-test of `.agents/skills/jit-project-lead/scripts/standards-scan.sh`, the content-standards scanner, over a self-contained `jit init` fixture seeded with issues and documents for each asserted finding. It exits 2 when `jit`, `jq` or `gawk` is missing. Until planning, no gate ran it. The gate `standards-scan-test` was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning, so this task and the container can require it; this task makes it pass and keeps its inputs complete.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `standards-scan-test` runs `.agents/skills/jit-project-lead/scripts/test-standards-scan.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `standards-scan-test` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
title: Standards-scan test suite runs as a declared gate
